answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The walnut edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 188 clones produces a signature the garden analysis flags immediately. An attacker must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, and hence doing work rather than printing keys, and the karst settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
